# Embedded item drift — placed creature copies vs. item blueprints

A placed creature embeds a **full copy** of every item it carries; its blueprint names items by resref only. Until it first dies after a reboot it wears and drops the embedded copies. `se_respawn_inc.nss` rebuilds it from the `.utc`, so **every respawn after that — and the wiki — uses the `.uti` blueprint**. Each row below is a creature whose first kill of the day is not the creature players meet the rest of the day.

**Why the divergence gate missed it:** `tests/check_divergent_creatures.py` compares gear by slot, resref and `Dropable`. It never opened the embedded item. The drift is inherited from the toolset era (an item edited inside a placed creature's inventory gets an instance-only copy, often with a `…2` tag; numeric resrefs like `044` were later reused for different items). Nothing in this repo's own history caused it: no pair was in sync at the first import (`e1fc8e2f249`) and drifted after.

**867 pairs** on **197 creature blueprints**, 3139 placed copies; 44 different-item, 138 stats, 13 identity, 672 cosmetic; 662 droppable.

Recommended: 75 `placed`, 792 `blueprint`. Decided so far: 0.

## How to decide

Set `decision` on a row in `tests/embedded_item_drift.json` to:

- `placed` — the placed copy is the real item: mint (or reuse an identical) blueprint from it and point the creature and all its placements at it. Every respawn then matches the first kill.
- `blueprint` — the `.uti` is right: resync the placed copies to it. Only the first kill of the day changes.

Then `python3 bin/fix-embedded-item-drift.py` (dry run) and `--apply`. `--accept-recommended` applies the recommendation to every undecided row. Re-run this audit afterwards; resolved rows drop out.

The recommendation favours the **stronger** copy (NWN cost formula, `bin/loot_model.py` `CostModel`), overridden when the blueprint cannot be worn in that slot or a script tests only the placed tag (→ `placed`), and for cosmetic-only rows or ties (→ `blueprint`). With several placed variants the strongest is the candidate.

**† Rows on split blueprints (272).** `bin/split-divergent-creatures.py` baked those creature blueprints from placements, so their `.utc` carries a **full item struct** instead of naming the item by resref. 252 of them hold exactly the placed copy. Which copy the engine gives a respawn from such a struct — the struct itself, its `TemplateResRef`'s `.uti`, or nothing — has never been verified (hidden roadmap item `split-blueprint-embedded-items`). If it is the struct, those rows are not first-kill drift today, but they are still a blueprint that lies to the wiki. Either decision makes them unambiguous: the fixer rewrites the `.utc` entry in canonical resref form.

`tests/check_divergent_creatures.py` fails the repack on any drifting pair that is **not** in the decision file, or whose copies changed since it was recorded, so this list can only shrink.
